skill_name: Generate an apt description for a graphical representation of temperature variation in two cities over June.
workflow: The graph represents the comparison of temperature variations in two cities, City A and City B, in the month of June. The highest temperature in City A ranged from 21°C to 30°C while the highest temperature in City B ranged from 18°C to 27°C. The minimum temperature in both cities was around 18°C. This shows that City A was warmer than City B most of the time in June.
